newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius stocks continue sliding, volume down.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius stocks continue sliding, volume down.

text.p: The Mauritius bourse share index, semdex, continued to slide on Wednesday, dragged down mainly by lower prices in the investment sector, brokers said.
Semdex ended 1.43 points lower to 307.78 with transaction volume provisionally posted at 3.51 million rupees on 178,291 shares from 4.26 million rupees on 162,109 shares on Monday.

Bourse officials said the index touched its fourth consecutive year low as market sentiment remained hesitant in face of a local political uncertainty climate which was inducing a subdued outlook for the island's medium term economic future.

"Until these dark clouds clear up the political skies, trading on the market will remain like this. In the meantime, investors are remaining on the sidelines not interested in making any move," one dealer said.
Most investment stocks, which have the majority of their portfolio in listed shares, fell reflecting a semdex continuous downward slide from its 322.67 points level of September 9.
"Shares of leading companies behaved well today. But the investment sector is taking the blow with the 5 week decline of the semdex," the dealer added.
Mauritius Commercial Bank was unchanged at 70 rupees on 20,260 shares and State Bank of Mauritius remained at 8.40 rupees on 21,600 shares.
Mauritius Chemical Fertilisers Industries fell by 20 cents to 9.80 rupees on 1,700 shares and construction company Gamma Civic was one rupee lower to 15.50 rupees on 600 shares.
